lessons.symptom: Content removed permanently from the current snapshot remained in the app backup and could reappear after current-file corruption.
lessons.cause: Permanent deletion used the normal save path, which intentionally retained the prior snapshot as a recovery backup.
lessons.proposed_change: Require privacy deletion tests to inspect every app-managed recovery copy, not only the active model.
lessons.regression_check: Corrupt current after permanent deletion and verify backup recovery cannot restore deleted content; also inject both replacement failures.

lessons.symptom: A modal composer could be dismissed by back, barrier or drag while an asynchronous save was pending.
lessons.cause: Only sheet buttons observed the saving flag; the modal route retained its default dismissal paths.
lessons.proposed_change: For write overlays, add a delayed-save test covering all route dismissal paths and exactly-once persistence.
lessons.regression_check: While the fake repository gate is incomplete, back, barrier and drag leave the sheet visible; completion writes one Echo.

lessons.symptom: At iOS AX XXXL on an iPhone SE, the extended floating action label overflowed across the screen.
lessons.cause: The label-based FAB was not adapted for the platform's maximum accessibility text scale.
lessons.proposed_change: Include a smallest-phone maximum-Dynamic-Type runtime capture and use compact semantic controls when labels cannot fit.
lessons.regression_check: The 3.2x widget path reaches detail, editor and settings without exceptions; final AX XXXL screenshot shows an icon FAB within bounds.
